newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Red Back Mining now to list on ASX October 29.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Red Back Mining now to list on ASX October 29.

text.p: Western Australian explorer Red Back Mining NL said on Friday it would start trading on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) on October 29.
The company had planned to start trading this week but the listing was delayed by ASX regulatory requirements, Ross Ashton, managing director of Red Back, told Reuters.

The decision to list the comapny followed an over-subscribed issue of 25 million shares at 20 cents each, raising A$5 million. Red Back Mining has proposed exploration of seven nickel, base metal and gold properties in Western Australia.
Initial exploration will focus on the Irwin Hills nickel prospect, 90 km east of the town of Laverton, Ashton said.
WMC Ltd can earn up to 60 percent of the Irwin Hills project by funding exploration through a bankable feasibility study, Ashton said.
"It is time that the junior explorers got involved in grass roots nickel exploration," Ashton said.

Among the company's non-nickel projects is the Deep Well prospect, 175 km northeast of Kalgoorlie, which contains a measured and indicated resource of 34,700 tonnes of ore, grading 2.9 grams of gold per tonne, with untested potential over 1.1 km of strike and at depth, Ashton said.
The company also has a 97 square km Balagundi prospect, eight km south of the Nimbus gold, silver and base metal deposit.
